audit.independent_solution: Because AC∥OB, the angle ACO equals BOC=50°. OA=OC gives OAC=50°, hence AOC=80°. Therefore AOB=80°+50°=130°. In isosceles triangle AOB, OAB=(180−130)/2=25°, choice A.
